videos.title: The $8 million AI music scam | The Vergecast
videos.description:
A man named Mike Smith was recently sentenced to 18 months in prison, and a fine in excess of $8 million, for creating an AI system that faked billions of streams and earned him millions in royalties. Wired's Kate Knibbs explains how Smith pulled it off, how he got caught, and what this case means for the internet's growing slop problems.

videos.title: Apple's new HomePod Mini 2 and Apple TV 4K
videos.description:
The HomePod Mini 2 costs $149, $20 more than its predecessor, which is being discontinued. The last update the Mini received was back in 2022 when Apple released new colors. The new Apple TV 4K costs $299, more than twice the price the prior-generation Apple TV 4K debuted at and $50 more than the current top-of-the-line model (which is also being discontinued).

videos.title: First look at Apple Home Collection
videos.description:
Apple’s new Home Collection features six devices developed with LG and Schneider Electric: three security cameras and a video doorbell that work with Apple’s HomeKit Secure Video, along with a UWB-enabled smart lock and two smart thermostats. The devices don’t have a release date yet, but when they launch, Apple promises a seamless setup process and integration with its new HomeView smart display. What do you think? Do these make you want to get started with the smart home?

Apple just announced its long-rumored HomeView smart home hub.
